title: Ads vs Offers Explained Simply | Marketing Management Ep 29
description:
Diwali is three weeks away and every sweet shop in Bengaluru is shouting. How can a tiny brand be heard, and sell more this month? In this animated lesson Laddoo Lab, a millet laddoo brand from Bengaluru, uses two tools: advertising and sales promotion.

You will see Philip Kotler and Gary Armstrong's definitions of advertising (paid, non-personal, by an identified sponsor) and sales promotion (short-term incentives to buy now), and the three jobs of an ad: inform, persuade and remind. Then we watch six weeks of Laddoo Lab sales: the ad lifts sales slowly, the festive offer (buy two 6-packs, get a mini gift pack free) makes them jump, and after the offer ends sales stay higher than before. We meet four sales promotion tools (samples, coupons, premiums and point of purchase displays) and see them at work today in a phone maker, a cold drink brand, a food delivery app and a supermarket. We also look at the human side honestly: too many offers teach people to wait for deals, and in India the Advertising Standards Council of India, set up in 1985, says ads must be honest and truthful.

This is Episode 29 of our Marketing Management series for MBA, BBA and commerce students.
